address: 95 Upland Road, Kelburn, Wellington, 6012, New Zealand
bio: The eco-conscious husband-and-wife team may have picked a former neighbourhood butcher’s shop for their wine bar, but their menu is entirely meat-free! While many come for the libations, their small plates made with responsibly-sourced plants and seafood are just as worthy of attention. Check out the blackboard menu for the day’s catch and foraged ingredients, which spins daily according to season and weather.
